items.item:
12. An accepted import stores every picked project with its rooms and
    pointers, the Customers it made, one closure holding the file's digest and
    exactly one audit entry; a failure inside its transaction leaves none of
    them — no project, room, pointer, Customer, closure or entry.
   Shows A16-1. [witness: verification:registry_a16_accepted_import_stores_all_in_one_transaction]
statements:
```text
import(file f, picks P) accepted =>   -- A16-1
  stored(P with rooms, pointers) and stored(new customers of P)
  and closure.file_digest = digest(f) and one AuditEntry, in one transaction
exists closure => import refused   -- A16-2
conflict at confirmation => store unchanged   -- A16-3
```

verdicts.why: The check verifies the exact picked project, room, pointer, and Customer rows and their relationships, plus a single closure containing the file digest and a single linked audit entry. It injects a failure at the late audit-entry write, detects transaction failure, and asserts the entire store snapshot is unchanged and every imported entity table and Customer list remain empty.
